questions.question: A die is in the position shown in the picture. It can be rolled along the path of 12 squares as shown. How many times must the die go around the path in order for it to return to its initial position with all faces in the initial positions?

A stick consists of 27 building blocks.
The stick is split into two pieces so that one is twice as long as the other. This operation is repeated by selecting one of the resulting pieces and splitting it in the same ratio. Which of the following pieces can never result?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E

A cube has side length $12 \mathrm{~cm}$. Find the length of the route shown on its surface from point $M$ to point $N$.
Choices:
A:40 cm
B:48 cm
C:50 cm
D:60 cm
E:It is impossible to determine

A cuboid consists of three building blocks. Each building block has a different colour and is made up of 4 cubes. What does the white building block look like?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E

Seven identical dice (each with 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 points on their faces) are glued together to form the solid shown. Faces that are glued together each have the same number of points. How many points can be seen on the surface of the solid?

A cube is rolled on a plane around its edges. Its bottom face passes through positions $1,2,3,4,5,6$ and 7 in that order, as shown. Which two of these positions were occupied by the same face of the cube?
Choices:
A:1 and 7
B:1 and 6
C:1 and 5
D:2 and 7
E:2 and 6

The numbers on each pair of opposite faces on a die add up to 7. A die is rolled without slipping around the circuit shown. At the start the top face is 3. What number will be displayed on the top face at the end point?

A cuboid is made of four pieces as shown. Each piece consists of four cubes and is a single colour. What is the shape of the white piece?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E
